overview: Retrospective review of incident reports and the pharmacy intervention log for the three shortage episodes, estimating substitution-related error rates by episode; revised to drop the framework and to add a pre-shortage baseline period for each product.
population: All doses of the three products dispensed during their shortage episodes and during the three months before each episode, with the incident reports and intervention log entries for the same periods.
exposure: Dispensing of a substituted product during a shortage episode, compared with the original product in the three months before.
procedures: As before, with the same search terms applied to the three months before each episode to estimate the baseline error rate for the original product.

outcomes.name: Substitution-related medication errors
outcomes.measure: Errors per 1,000 doses dispensed during each episode, with the rate for the original product in the three months before
outcomes.why: A baseline shows how much the substitution added.

outcomes.name: Error type and stage
outcomes.measure: Distribution by error type and stage

outcomes.name: Errors reaching the patient
outcomes.measure: Proportion reaching the patient, with harm category

summary: Protocol revised: pre-episode baseline added; no framework, because none changes what is measured.
